title: 2023-2025: Just Released
desc: Fresh from the multiplex — the latest films and their secrets

questions.q: 'Oppenheimer' and 'Barbie' released on the same day, spawning what internet phenomenon?
questions.a: Barbenheimer — people bought double-feature tickets and dressed in themed outfits for both

questions.q: In 'Poor Things' (2023), what is Bella Baxter's journey fundamentally a metaphor for?
questions.a: A woman's intellectual and sexual liberation — she's essentially experiencing an accelerated version of growing up free from patriarchal constraints

questions.q: 'Killers of the Flower Moon' (2023) tells the true story of murders in which Native American nation during the 1920s?
questions.a: The Osage Nation — members were systematically murdered for their oil wealth headrights

questions.q: What connects 'Past Lives' (2023) and 'Lost in Translation' (2003)?
questions.a: Both are quiet, intimate films about connection and missed timing between two people in a foreign city — and both deliberately leave the ending ambiguous

questions.q: 'Saltburn' (2023) ends with Barry Keoghan doing what that went viral?
questions.a: Dancing naked through the mansion to 'Murder on the Dancefloor' — after revealing the full extent of his manipulation

questions.q: 'The Holdovers' (2023) is set in the 1970s at a boarding school. Which 1980s film is it most frequently compared to?
questions.a: Dead Poets Society — though tonally it's closer to Harold and Maude or The Breakfast Club

questions.q: Denis Villeneuve's 'Dune: Part Two' (2024) introduced which key character played by Austin Butler?
questions.a: Feyd-Rautha Harkonnen — the Baron's psychopathic nephew and Paul's ultimate rival

questions.q: What connects 'The Substance' (2024) and David Cronenberg's 'The Fly' (1986)?
questions.a: Both are body horror films that use grotesque physical transformation as a metaphor — aging and beauty standards in 'The Substance', hubris and disease in 'The Fly'

questions.q: 'Anora' won the Palme d'Or at Cannes 2024. What's it about in one sentence?
questions.a: A Brooklyn sex worker marries the son of a Russian oligarch, then his family tries to annul the marriage — a modern Cinderella story that goes sideways

questions.q: Which 2024 animated sequel became the fastest animated film to cross $1 billion worldwide?
